clues.text: Naaman, commander of the Aramean army, was a great and mighty man of valor, but he had this.
A captive girl from Israel told Naaman's wife that the prophet in Samaria could cure him of this.
After a commander dipped seven times in the Jordan, his flesh became like a child's and this was gone.
Elisha told Gehazi this would cling to him for taking gifts, and he left white as snow.
Four men with this sat at the entrance of Samaria's gate, asking why they should wait there to die.
While King Uzziah raged at the priests with a censer in his hand, this broke out on his forehead.
Jesus reached out His hand, touched a man, and said, "I am willing. Be clean!" Then this left him.
